issue.title: provider: TestAccountListFollowsTheVendor red under load (the fake vendor's list asked 0 times)
issue.body:
`TestAccountListFollowsTheVendor` (internal/provider) went red in a full `go test ./... -timeout 45m` on mote (macOS 27, load 60 to 250 from several sessions' suites), 10-28 23:40 to 10-29 00:35, at a tree that is origin/main e15b2277c plus a Library-only change (internal/library, internal/agent's WSL memory, internal/cli's library listing, the Library plugin's assets), none of which internal/provider imports for this test:

```
codex: Get "http://127.0.0.1:64947/backend-api/codex/models?client_version=0.159.0": context deadline exceeded
--- FAIL: TestAccountListFollowsTheVendor (6.55s)
    account_relist_test.go:65: FetchNew: asked 0, serves []
```

Run alone at the same tree on mote at load ~34 it passed (`go test -count=1 ./internal/provider -run 'TestAccountListFollowsTheVendor'`). So it is a timing assumption a busy machine breaks, not shown to be a regression; the cause isn't found. Not taking it.

comments.body:
A test-only fix is on [fix/4234-account-list-test-budget](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/4234-account-list-test-budget), commit [1a15ba47](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/1a15ba47080ad6b3d6659495b1dad355b577e91b), based on upstream `ed0ab567`.

The account-list behavior test now calls the real `FetchNew` synchronously with the test's remaining deadline, rather than using five seconds as part of the functional assertion. It still uses a real local HTTP vendor, checks the account header, and retains the freshness, added-model, error-preservation and switched-off-account assertions. A separate virtual-clock transport test checks that a one-second caller budget actually cancels the request. Production timeouts are unchanged.

The controlled base test reproduces expiration after the request arrives (`asked 1, serves []`), not the report's exact `asked 0` scheduler state. The focused tests pass with `-race`, including the deterministic deadline test; provider vet and nogui build pass. The empty-list/wrong-account mutation checks were done before the final synchronous cleanup revision; I independently reran all three final tests. Full provider and macOS stress runs were not performed. AI-assisted implementation and review.
